cross_module_relations.name: pos_to_finance_boundary
cross_module_relations.business_meaning: Use M12 for POS/promotion transactions, then move to M2 when the user asks for journal posting, cash-bank, or general-ledger context.
cross_module_relations.join_rule: Do not assume a single stable direct foreign key from M12 to M2 unless the active source explicitly shows it.

cross_module_relations.name: pos_to_inventory_boundary
cross_module_relations.business_meaning: Use M12 for retail transactions and POS items, then move to M3 when the user asks for stock or warehouse-mutation context.
cross_module_relations.join_rule: Do not assume a single stable direct foreign key from M12 to M3 unless the active source explicitly shows it.

guardrails: Prefer transaction tables for sales analysis
Use history tables only for audit/history requests
Do not infer accounting postings unless source query explicitly supports it
